thread:
maria: Hey team — putting together a requirements list for the A/B delta dashboard we promised PM. Need to confirm what runtime/infra signals we can reliably emit for every routed request.
kevin: high-level — we can emit: model_variant, route, rollout_id, bucket_id, request_id, token_count, gen_time_ms (per-request), queue_time_ms, batch_size, kv_cache_hit (bool), quant_fallback (bool). Most are cheap.
sophia: Console needs p50/p90/p99 latency slices + success rate + tokens per request per cohort. Also ability to split by route + model_variant in the same panel.
maria: important: minimize cardinality explosion. Suggest we limit bucket_id to "control"/"canary" or small ints, and restrict rollouts to a single active tag per request.
james: +1 on cardinality. From SRE side we also want backend error reason tag (model_timeout, oom, invalid_request) and a coarse host_pool label (region/pool) for correlation.
ash: Also need uplift & regression signals — what's the proposed stat test? t-test? bayesian? we need UX constraints (when to flag an automatic regression alert).
kevin: instrumentation: runtime will add header "X-RW-Rollout: id=R123;bucket=canary" on forwarded requests so infra can attach labels. For internal metrics we can emit JSON logs like: {
  "ts": "...",
  "r": "REQ",
  "rollout_id": "R123",
  "bucket": "canary",
  "lat_ms": 42,
  "tokens": 128
}
 (we'll compress but keep keys stable)
sophia: That log schema is fine but console prefers metrics ingestion rather than log parsing. Can we have a metrics exporter/pusher that converts a sample into Prom-like time series? We want cardinality-limited label set.
maria: proposal: metrics labels = {route, model_variant, rollout_id, bucket, region, status}. Keep rollout_id optional; if present dashboard treats it as cohort.
james: sampling — suggest 10% full event sampling and 100% of aggregated metrics (counts, lat buckets) emitted. For debug-rollouts we can ramp to 100%.
kevin: runtime can emit aggregated counters every 10s: requests_total{labels}, errors_total{labels}, latency_histogram{labels}, tokens_total{labels}. That avoids heavy ingestion.
ash: For delta calculation, we want side-by-side time series and an automated windowed A/B test with configurable baseline window. UX should show absolute delta, pct delta, and 95% conf interval.
sophia: Also add a small table for example requests that went to each cohort (sampled) with anonymized prompt hash, so product can inspect failure patterns.
maria: ownership question: eng-runtime owns the headers/metrics emission. eng-platform owns ingestion, alert rules, and dashboard rendering. Can we get commit owners? kevin/james pair on runtime; sophia/maria for dashboard.
kevin: ack, I'll add the header + aggregated emit patch. PR will include unit tests and a small benchmark for emission overhead (<1%).
james: infra-bot: rolling alert policy created: canary_regression_rule v1 -> triggers when p95 latency delta > 20% and error_rate delta > 2% for 5m.
infra-bot: NOTE: alert policy created in staging only. Use /policy promote to push to prod.
sophia: UI note — please ensure dashboard supports switching baseline cohort (control vs all) and auto-align by traffic-weighted time windows.
ash: For thresholding, let's not hardcode. Default to statistical test (Welch's t or bootstrap) with optional hard SLO delta overrides.
maria: action items: 1) kevin: PR for header + metrics emit (due EOD Wed). 2) james: staging alert + test playbook (due Thu). 3) sophia: dashboard mock + API contract for labels (due Fri). 4) ash: confirm PM acceptance criteria and rollout playbook.
kevin: quick snippet for header we'll use in runtime (for reviewers):

```
// added to outgoing inference request
headers.set('X-RW-Rollout', `id=${rolloutId};bucket=${bucket}`)
```

kevin: also adding Metrics payload example (aggregated):

```
metrics.emit({
  route: '/v1/generate',
  model_variant: 'redwood-1-quant',
  rollout_id: 'R123',
  bucket: 'canary',
  region: 'us-west1',
  requests: 24,
  errors: 1,
  latency_p50_ms: 38,
  latency_p95_ms: 210,
  tokens: 3072
})
```

maria: good. keep label names snake_case in contract doc. sophia — can you add a short section about max label cardinality (<=10k series) and recommend rollouts limit to 5 concurrent cohorts per route?
sophia: will do. one UX Q: do we want automatic rollback suggestions? maybe just a strong recommend and link to rollout actions in console.
ash: let's avoid automated rollback for now. suggest a "recommend rollback" card with confidence level and links to runbook.
james: final Q — do we need per-request KV cache hit metric? it's useful for cost analysis. kevin: cheap to emit as aggregated hits/requests count.
maria: thanks everyone. I'll draft the contract doc and post a PR to the eng-platform repo. If anyone wants to add edge cases (e.g., multi-rollout stacking), drop comments on the PR. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: eng-runtime/rollout-metrics-emu -> staging at 2026-06-01T02:00:00Z"
